climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Veneto white wine denomination from four communes including Gambellara. Its rules allow still and quality sparkling wine from Garganega, Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco and Trebbiano di Soave. Garganega is also among the main grapes of Veneto.
